newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to name new Cabinet officers Friday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to name new Cabinet officers Friday.

text.p: Incoming White House Chief of Staff Erskine Bowles said on Wednesday that President Bill Clinton was expected to name additional Cabinet secretaries on Friday.

"We'll make some additional announcements on Friday and hopefully perhaps we'll be able to do most of them on Friday," Bowles told reporters. "We may do a few after that, but we continue to be on plan."
Having named new secretaries of state, defense and commerce, Clinton has to fill vacancies at the departments of labor, energy, and transportation, as well as housing and urban development.
